summary: P01 V2.47.131 stale-success favicon self-heal. OWNER Production diagnostics proved cocodot link 845 reported raw icon_cache status success while Navigation still rendered a text initial. Root cause: persisted status=success could be unusable when URL/icon signature drifted or the cached file disappeared; decorateLinks correctly refused the asset but left status reported as success, so visible recovery could remain permanently suppressed, especially on legacy installs with automatic icon fetching disabled. V2.47.131 derives an effective stale state from signature/file reality, makes diagnostics report stale instead of false success, exposes the effective state to both row/card render paths, and lets visible Navigation repair only stale-success rows even when ordinary auto-fetch is disabled. Provider architecture, SVG security validation, schema/data model, updater mechanism and Production remain unchanged. Exact focused proof preserves V2.47.127 reliability, V2.47.128 recovery queue, V2.47.130 provider-generation behavior and adds stale-success self-heal coverage. OWNER explicitly continued the release chain; OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Production remains OWNER manual.
